## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational problem and the resulting behavior.

## Changes

- Describe the concrete implementation changes.

## Verification

List the exact commands, tests, or deployment checks run.

## Release And Operations Impact

Note compatibility, configuration, migration, security, cost, rollback, and
AgentCore/Fargate deployment effects. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated when required.
- [ ] Generated files and dependency locks are current.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, internal collateral, or build artifacts are included.
- [ ] Production changes have a bounded rollback path.
